Looking at historical patterns, this series tends to show gradual growth over time with occasional weekly fluctuations. Week-to-week changes can go either direction but the long-term trend has been upward, especially in recent years with higher interest rates making money market funds attractive. For any given single week comparison, there's roughly a slight edge toward increases given the general upward trend, but weekly volatility means decreases are also common.
